quarterly_data.quarter: Naver press release: TEAM NAVER Digital Twin Platform Adopted as Saudi Arabia's (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer Saudi Ministry of Municipalities and Housing: TEAM NAVER's cloud-based digital twin platform received official approval from Saudi Arabia's Digital Government Authority (DGA) for use by municipalities and was adopted as the Saudi government's national standard digital twin platform; the Ministry of Municipalities and Housing issued an official notice recommending that municipalities nationwide give priority to TEAM NAVER's platform for digital twin and smart-city projects (urban planning, city operations, asset and infrastructure management, urban safety). The ministry originally awarded TEAM NAVER the contract for major cities in October 2023; deployments in Makkah, Madinah and Jeddah were completed in 2025 (more than 920,000 buildings across 6,800 square kilometers). No contract value is stated.
quarterly_data.figure: national standard digital twin platform (DGA approval, 08-20-2026); no contract value stated
